subject.title: fix(brave): use own-property checks for credential field lookups

question: Should Brave credential resolution require own-property traversal across every segment of both supported credential paths?
rationale: The PR claims to close the prototype-chain credential surface but protects only terminal fields; accepting a narrower boundary or hardening the complete paths is an owner-level security-contract choice.

options.title: Harden complete paths
options.body: Require own-property traversal for every intermediate and terminal segment, with focused compatibility tests and real-module proof.

options.title: Accept terminal-only protection
options.body: Narrow the PR's security claim and explicitly treat inherited intermediate configuration objects as trusted.

recommendation.title: Harden complete paths
recommendation.body: Require own-property traversal for every intermediate and terminal segment, with focused compatibility tests and real-module proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current Brave credential descriptor and both affected lookup paths.
